newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Qinqi '96 pretax profit $96 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's Qinqi '96 pretax profit $96 mln.

text.p: China's Jinan Qinqi Motorcycle Co Ltd manufactured 1.45 million motorcycles in 1996, generating a pre-tax profit of more than 800 million yuan ($96 million), the China News Service said on Wednesday.
The company's industrial output value was 7.44 billion yuan in 1996 and exports earned the firm more than $20 million in foreign exchange, the agency said.
Qinqi now held more than 18 percent of China's motorcycle market, it said.
The firm had set up 12 overseas trading companies and had some 3,000 retail outlets and more than 1,000 service centres, the agency said, but gave no further details.
Qinqi was among the 33 domestic companies named by the Securities Commission of the State Council on Tuesday as candidates for B share listing.
The company expects to launch an offer of 200 million B shares in the first half of 1997 and list them in Shanghai, a company spokesman said.
